01 / The challenge

The challenge for care & healthcare.

Home-care and community healthcare teams run fleets of small cars visiting people at home. Graphics should be calm and trustworthy, help clients recognise their carer, and support recruitment too.

01

Small cars, many drivers

Care fleets are often small hatchbacks driven by different staff.

02

Trust and reassurance

Clients and families want to recognise who is arriving.

03

Recruitment

Many care firms use their cars to attract new staff.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Organisation name
  • Home care, clinic or community service
  • Phone number
  • A recruitment line, e.g. “Now hiring carers”

Not sure what to include? Our guide to what to put on a work van walks you through it.

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Keep it calm

Soft colours and clear type feel reassuring.

02

Add a recruitment line

“Now hiring carers” with a web address can bring in applicants.

03

Plan for leased cars

Choose removable films so graphics can come off at the end of a lease.

Before you book

Good to know.

Can graphics be removed from leased cars?

Yes. Quality vinyl removes cleanly when the lease ends.

Can we add a recruitment message?

Yes. Many care providers add a short hiring line and web address.

Can you do the fleet in stages?

Yes. We can fit a few cars at a time so visits are not affected.
